cases.title: A capitalized process API bound to a name hides a real verify push
cases.given: janitor.py with P = subprocess.Popen, a subclass of subprocess.Popen, Popen as a default parameter value, or [subprocess.Popen][0]
cases.when: push_guard.py runs on each copy; the first mutant runs against a local bare origin
cases.then: each output differs from the pins
cases.expected: a changed key for each form, as for f = subprocess.run (TC-cli-15) and sp = subprocess (TC-cli-40)
cases.actual: exit 0 and output equal to the pins for all 4 forms. The proof run pushes refs/heads/sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0. Cause: Scanner.check_value returns early when the last name part starts with a capital letter, so subprocess.Popen as a value is never reported.
cases.specSource: tests.md R-119 scope and refutation rule (ADR-20261009-062930-decision-judge-S-005-388e)

seeds.title: S3: a process or network module re-exported by another module
seeds.detail: shutil.os.system(...), tempfile._os.system(...), branches.subprocess.run(...) in janitor.py and socketserver.socket.create_connection(...) in hub.py leave the output equal to the pins. The shutil.os proof run pushes refs/heads/sdlc/S-001-v0-http-api-0. These are attribute walks to a module, so they are S3. Report a chain whose last name is a process call (for example any q ending in .system or .run where a middle part is a watched module) to close it. Test: TC-cli-59 at .sdlc/slices/S-005/verification/r1/tests/cli-0/push-guard.verify-cli.test.mjs:449.

seeds.title: A utf8 cookie spelled without a dash makes a file opaque
seeds.detail: tokenize.detect_encoding returns 'utf8' for '# coding: utf8', and the scanner accepts only 'utf-8' and 'utf-8-sig'. This fails closed, so it is safe, but a valid UTF-8 file with that cookie breaks the opaque pin. Normalise with codecs.lookup(encoding).name.
